name: Titanium.UI.Android.CollapseToolbar
description:
| Android |
| ------- |
| ![Android](./collpasetoolbar_android.jpg) |

CollapseToolbar acts as a top-level container for window content that allows to set a parallax image and title
in the toolbar. The main content goes into `centerView` and will automatically be scrollable.

examples.title: Simple setup

properties.name: barColor
properties.summary: Background color of the extended toolbar when no image is shown.

properties.name: contentScrimColor
properties.summary: Background color of the small toolbar when the content is scrolled up.

properties.name: displayHomeAsUp
properties.summary: Displays an "up" affordance on the "home" area of the action bar.
properties.description:
See also: [setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/ActionBar.html#setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(boolean))
in the Android Developer Reference.

properties.name: flags
properties.summary: Scroll flags. Check [Android documentation](https://developer.android.com/reference/com/google/android/material/appbar/AppBarLayout.LayoutParams#constants_1) for more details.

properties.name: image
properties.summary: Background image for the full size toolbar. Has a parallax effect when scrolling upwards.

properties.name: imageHeight
properties.summary: Height of the image. Use `height` for the height of the extended toolbar.

properties.name: onHomeIconItemSelected
properties.summary: Callback function called when the home icon is clicked.
